video_title: How Anthony Edwards Gets ready for a New Season

quotes.speaker: Anthony Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards on the importance of team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: we got to start early, we got to actually get to know each other
quotes.quote: I feel like in the past years we didn't really spend time with each other in the summer. It was just like everybody go on and do their own thing. But it's like, we want to win, we got to start early, we got to actually get to know each other, we got to want to be there for each other.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards on the Timberwolves' new locker room dynamic
quotes.excerpt: I think it's going to mesh well together. It's going to be like a brotherhood.
quotes.quote: I'm super happy about the changes in the locker room. I think we got a great group of guys. You got me, you got Melo, you got I-O, you got Jaden, you got Bones, T-J, then you got Rudy. Just a bunch of different personalities and I think it's going to mesh well together. It's going to be like a brotherhood. Everybody is super cool with each other. Anybody that play for the Timberwolves plus Naz Reid, I'm their biggest fan.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards' advice for young athletes
quotes.excerpt: Everyday, wake up and find a way to get 1% better, everyday.
quotes.quote: Don't stop, man. Everyday, wake up and find a way to get 1% better, everyday.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards on being the face of the league
quotes.excerpt: don't let nobody tell you that there's another face in the league but five.
quotes.quote: Hey man, don't let nobody tell you that there's another face in the league but five. The face of the league wears number five, man. Believe that.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Edwards
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards picks his ideal starting five
quotes.excerpt: I would put Lamelo at PG, Anthony Edwards at SG, Jaden McDaniels at SF, Jonathan Kuminga at PF
quotes.quote: I would put Lamelo at PG, Anthony Edwards at SG, Jaden McDaniels at SF, Jonathan Kuminga at PF, Rudy Gobert at C.
